headline: Zərdab: Regional district with low population density and limited infrastructure

tags.reason: This area features a flat terrain and a mean elevation of -5 meters, with a nature index of 8 compared to the national median of 51.
The area has a population density of 70 residents per km² across 843.8 km² with no available property price data in listings.

summary: Zərdab is a regional district with a population of 60,100 residents and a density of 70 residents per km² across 843.8 km². The district provides 0.33 pharmacies and 2.66 groceries per 10,000 residents, compared to the national median of 0.18 and 2.29 respectively. The infrastructure index is 83 with a known paved roads share of 17.4%, while the education index stands at 30 against the national median of 53. OSM coverage is medium, and price data is currently unavailable.
